quickref.status: Default since BBG 2.1 (Jul 2013); seen in Aug 2026 playtest thumbnails; returns as Botch's Super in BB Heroes (2024)
quickref.look: A translucent lime jelly-starfish blob (#B0F524–#B4FE22) with about 5 drooping points. It is 0.6–0.8 Botch-heads and floats beside his shoulder. HUD icon: a lime starfish with a white dome.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: It spins and rises overhead, then rains long tapering lime needles that yellow at the tips. The spread widens with height. It lasts 4 s and Botch cannot melee or switch weapons meanwhile.
quickref.impact_end_result: Damage only, and it hits through roofs. Needles make yellow V-splashes on the floor. At the end the cloud sinks and peters out in a green flash, and it self-destructs if Botch dies or the cloud hits a surface.

quickref.status: 100,000 Joules; present at 2.1; reworked in 2.6; in 2026 playtests, with the HUD showing 3/3 in the Oct 2026 thumbnail vs a 2-round clip in the wiki
quickref.look: A large translucent lime skeletal hand made of faceted crystal bone segments (#9CF529–#AEFB21). It is about 1 Botch-head and floats beside his paw. HUD icon: a lime skeletal hand.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: The hand lobs a 'gleaming blob' on a slight arc at 1,250 u/s, about one per second. Yellow-green motes and green rays appear near targets; the blob itself has not been clearly seen.
quickref.impact_end_result: No direct-hit damage. The blob bursts into a low, rolling olive-green puffball cloud (#366321–#63A840) that poisons for 12/s over 6 s and stacks; Botch can poison himself. A skull icon appears over victims.

quickref.status: 50 Gas, Level 10; added in 2.17 (Mar 8, 2015); not seen in 2026
quickref.look: A pale-green lumpy bulb like a cabbage or onion, with a stem. It is about 0.3 Botch-heads and floats in a green glow.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A thrown ball at 600 u/s that ricochets wildly off surfaces, projectiles and players, leaving a green gas trail. One per clip.
quickref.impact_end_result: A glowing lime gas column or haze (#6DEB13–#ADFF12, yellow #FCFD28 core) that poisons at 18/s for 3 s and stacks the more victims move in it.

quickref.status: 60 Gas; added in 2.3 (Sep 27, 2013); changed in 2.6, with a conflict over duration (5 vs 10 s); not seen in 2026
quickref.look: A palm flame with a white-hot core, lime tongues (#89C420→#B6FA23) and teal sparks, about 0.5 Botch-heads. It is the 'green flame' in the DefaultBotch2 and skin screenshots. HUD icon: a flame.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: His palm thrusts forward and the flame becomes a broad, medium-range pale yellow-lime flamethrower jet (#FBFE6F core) that passes through enemies. In the concept art it is a long wavy lime stream.
quickref.impact_end_result: Continuous damage (65 DPS listed) to everyone in the cone. No status effect; specials are blocked while firing.

quickref.status: 60 Gas; added in 2.7 (Jan 23, 2014); HUD shows 50 rounds vs the wiki's 60; not seen in 2026
quickref.look: Two orbs, one hovering over each paw. Each has a lime swirled core inside a faceted yellow-white halo, about 0.25 Botch-heads, and reads bright yellow (#F6FC37) in play. HUD icon: a solid lime disc.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A continuous rapid laser (0.05 s, 3 damage per shot) until the clip is empty. Faint thin pale-yellow beam lines are visible only at low resolution.
quickref.impact_end_result: The target glows in a lime halo with white flashes. Hit damage only, followed by a long 5–6 s reload.

quickref.status: 60 Gas; added in 2.7; 2.17 damage glitch fixed in 2.19 (Apr 2015); 4 rounds confirmed on the HUD; not seen in 2026
quickref.look: A glowing lime sea-mine ball with short pyramid spikes (#8BCA1B/#B2F839). It is about 0.25 Botch-heads and floats above his shoulder. HUD icon: a spiked ball.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: One trigger fires bombs in all 4 directions around Botch. The bombs have not been seen in flight.
quickref.impact_end_result: Each bomb explodes on contact (25–35 splash). The one blast seen is an orange-yellow fireball with rays (attribution is inference). No status effect.

quickref.status: 60 Gas; added in 2.27 (May 29, 2017); missing from the wiki class page but in Category:Assassin; HUD ammo 4 (2018) then 3 (2021/2024); not seen in 2026
quickref.look: A three-bladed fidget spinner of dark translucent bottle-green (#1D501F) with lime rims and a ringed hub, about 1 Botch-head across. HUD icon: a radiation trefoil.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Spinners fly straight at 1,100 u/s, skimming low; 1.5 s rate of fire.
quickref.impact_end_result: An explosion (25–50) and weak stacking poison (4 per second over 5 s). Seen as dark-purple skull-faced puffballs (#53246D) and a purple skull bubble (attribution is inference).

quickref.status: Default since 2.1; a pink secondary icon in the Oct 2026 thumbnail is probably this weapon
quickref.look: Idle: a small pink-red honeycomb orb (#E25569), about 0.3 Botch-heads, at his side. His only magenta weapon. HUD icon: a pink hex ball.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Deployed in place. It balloons into a huge translucent magenta-violet sphere of faceted hex plates (#B456D2–#DD56F1) that lasts 15 s.
quickref.impact_end_result: No damage of its own. Everyone inside, allies included, takes 50% more damage. No overhead icon and no slow.

quickref.status: 60 Gas per the wiki (the 2.1 store may show 100); at launch in 2.1 after a pre-release poison change; reworked in 2.6; seen in 2024; not seen in 2026
quickref.look: Two lime soccer-ball-lattice spheres (#A7F533), about 0.25 Botch-heads each, drifting around him and trailing yellow-green dots. HUD icon: a lattice ball.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: On activation the spheres orbit him violently for 5 s at very short range; his primary stays usable.
quickref.impact_end_result: Touch poisons for 24 DPS over the duration. Yellow-green skull-faced blob icons (#E3F47C) appear over victims (attribution is inference).

quickref.status: 120,000 Joules; added in 2.3; minimum damage raised in 2.6 (infobox 450 vs the 2.6 note's 400); not seen in 2026
quickref.look: Charge: a white-cored lime ball (#DDFD4B) held at his chest, lighting him green, about 0.4 Botch-heads.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A 3 s charge, then a lob straight up through roofs. It falls back about 10 s later as a vertical comet: yellow head (#FBFD75), white middle, cyan tail. It does not home.
quickref.impact_end_result: A big green translucent sphere blast (#5EF14A–#6BFD6A) with a white core and rising green rings. It hits the first surface it meets, can hurt Botch, and projectiles can detonate it.

quickref.status: 60 Gas; added in 2.7 (Jan 23, 2014); not seen in 2026
quickref.look: No held prop. HUD icon: a lime ring with radiating inner spikes, like a sunburst or iris.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A ground eruption: a 'huge column of green energy' springs up close to Botch. A green-white flare is seen at use.
quickref.impact_end_result: Two explosive hits (15–30 each) in a moderate area. The column stops at Botch's feet, so anyone directly under him is safe. No image of the column has been found.

quickref.status: 150,000 Joules; added in 2.7; HUD icon seen in the Sept 20, 2026 playtest
quickref.look: A glowing lime frisbee disc with a bright centre and segmented ring (#B9FD0A), about 0.5 Botch-heads. HUD icon: a disc with a dashed ring.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A fast straight throw at 650 u/s, 2 per clip; seen in flight as a flat lime ellipse streak.
quickref.impact_end_result: Explodes on any surface (40–50) as a translucent faceted lime dome (#72E464), sometimes with a cyan inner shell; enemies fly apart. Botch can kill himself with it.

quickref.status: Default since 2.1; equipment bonuses cut in 2.6; not seen in 2026
quickref.look: An oversized translucent lime crystal fist bristling with spikes (#AAF928–#B2FF23), 1.0–1.2 Botch-heads, floating over his paw.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A punch; the giant fist thrusts forward.

quickref.status: 45,000 Joules; present by Jul 2013; changed in 2.6; seen in a Sept 2026 playtest menu
quickref.look: A mottled green sphere with lime pyramid spikes (#4ADB0F/#99FD1D), about 0.9 Botch-heads, floating off his paw with no chain.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A swing; the huge spiked ball sweeps through the foreground.
quickref.impact_end_result: 40 melee damage and a +30% special-speed modifier. No status.

quickref.status: 20 Gas, Level 5; added in 2.21 (Jul 3, 2015); not seen in 2026
quickref.look: A physical nunchuck. Each stick has a black hex-mesh grip with red spiral stripes (#A91227), a silver spiked cap and a carved green fanged end (#417720–#6DE116), about 0.8 Botch-heads. Only one stick has been seen clearly.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A whirling nunchuck swing; a black-red stick with a green end was seen sweeping across an enemy (low resolution).
quickref.impact_end_result: 40 melee damage, +5% speed. No status. The chain or 'tongue' has not been seen.

quickref.status: BB Heroes basic attack only; not in BBR or BBG; damage +15% in BBH 1.0.12 (Oct 3, 2024)
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Per official text, a boomerang that flies out and returns.
quickref.impact_end_result: Can hit twice ('potentially dealing double damage'). No status stated.

open_questions: Which of Botch's 15 BBG weapons ship in the Nov 4, 2026 build? Fan thumbnails of the 2026 playtests show Doom Cloud, Chaos Toss, Gravity Well and Ball N Pain, plus a pink secondary icon that is probably Pain Field. The other 10 have not been seen; the JustNubz showcase (39:57–44:12) and the Oct 19–26 Next Fest demo are unwatched.
Is the Chaos Toss clip 3 in the 2026 release? The Oct 2026 final-playtest HUD shows 3/3 and 1/3, but the wiki, the 2013–2014 HUDs and Slinkster's Aug 2026 beta show 2.
Is the Orbs clip 50 or 60? Fan HUDs from 2014–2016 show 50; the wiki says 60. Is its reload 5 s (infobox) or 6 s (text)?
Hazard Toy ammo is 4 on a ~2018 HUD and 3 on 2021/2024 HUDs; when did it change, or was the 4 from equipment?
What did Fear Orbit cost in 2.1? The store screen seems to show '100' Gas; the wiki says 60.
Cosmic Fire: is the duration 5 s or 10 s after 2.6? Cosmic Bomb: is the minimum damage 400 or 450? SkyVu's 2.6 notes were unreachable (72 Wayback failures).
What does the Nova column look like (width, height, pulse)? No image was found.
What does the Orbs laser beam look like at full resolution? Only faint thin yellow lines were visible.
Energy Bombs: what do the bombs look like in flight, and is the orange-yellow fireball really theirs?
Is poison colour set per weapon? Hazard Toy shows purple skull puffs and Fear Orbit yellow-green skull blobs; the wiki says only 'purple/green skull'.
What causes the magenta-purple electric crackle around Botch's paws in many fan thumbnails across different weapons (Pain Field susceptibility, a special, or a team effect)?
Tonguechuks: what joins the two sticks, a chain or a literal 'tongue'? Is the green fanged end a creature head?
What does the BB Heroes Doom Star boomerang look like? No image has been found.
Are CosmicFireconceptart.png and CosmicBombConceptArt.png official? They carry a SkyVu watermark but were fan-uploaded in 2015.
Need the exact SkyVu wording for 2.3, 2.6, 2.7, 2.17 and 2.27 (archived battlebears.com posts), to replace the Fan-wiki version citations.
